text:
```yaml
name: Validate PR

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run PR validation
        uses: getsentry/github-workflows/.github/actions/validate-pr@main
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          maintainers-file: '.github/contributors.json'
          draft-status: true
```
